content.title: About
content.content: Baked potato (NFS) is a whole tuber baked in its skin without added fats. It retains most of its nutrients, has a characteristic aroma and a tender interior. The product is commonly used as a side dish or a standalone meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Baked potatoes retain up to 80 % of vitamin C, which is lost during boiling.
The skin provides dietary fiber that supports digestion.
In the United States, baked potatoes are often served with sour cream, cheese, or chives.
Potatoes are one of the most consumed vegetables worldwide, with over 350 million tonnes produced annually.
Baking at 200 °C creates a crisp crust rich in antioxidants.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate blood pressure and supports muscle function.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber improves digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Baked potato contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Contains vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 is involved in protein metabolism and neurotransmitter synthesis.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience an allergic reaction to potatoes.

items.title: Solanine content
items.content: Green spots and sprouts contain solanine, a toxin that should be removed before cooking.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Baked potatoes can raise blood sugar quickly; individuals with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Baked potato can be eaten hot, split open and topped with butter, sour cream, cheese, herbs or spices. It is also used in salads, casseroles, and as a base for various fillings.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store cooked baked potatoes in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to 3‑4 days. Reheat in the oven or microwave to restore a crisp skin.
